stage1.impression: A pale, airy birch wood in snow with the dark speaker set right of centre: the black-on-white idea reads at once, even as a thumbnail. But it is overexposed and flat. The snow is a near-white sheet with no sun modelling and weak contact. The birches read as clean CG poles with no branches. The 'smoke' is a grey smudge at the left that looks like dirty haze. The cabinet reads as neutral grey with no tint or light through the acrylic. As a whole it reads as a competent render, not a photograph.
